channel.title: Busy: what's new
channel.description: Every release of Busy, free, private tools for work and life.

item.title: Busy 1.0: Olaf, Ivy and Juno are here, and so is the whole of Busy Street
item.description: Each suite now also comes as a paid app with its AI expert inside: Busy Business with Olaf, Busy Growth with Ivy and Busy Home with Juno. You buy one once, on itch.io, and the expert runs on your own Claude key. The free tools stay free, with no AI and no account. Nothing about them has changed. Busy Street: Tuck's Errand has a full edition with 15 levels: the street and nine worlds. Busy Street 3D is out for Mac. The paid apps and both games are in English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. The website has a new page, Free and paid, and a short film of every app.

item.title: Busy 0.9.7: Busy Business starts with your brand
item.description: Busy Business opens on your brand: a brand card first, then your tools in three groups: Grow, Deliver and Run. In Busy Home's Just in Case binder, a contract or a document now opens in its own tool when you click it. Safer apps: a file Busy opens for you is only ever a document or a picture, and two windows can't trip over the same file. The website says plainly what is free and what will be paid: the tools stay free, and a paid version with an AI expert is coming.

item.title: Busy 0.9.6: A new free game: Busy Street: Tuck's Errand
item.description: Tuck only went out to get a stamp back. Six levels, six friends to cut loose from the Red Tape. Play it in your browser, or download it for Mac and Windows with a film at the start and end of every level. The AI experts are coming later, so the site no longer shows prices for them.

item.title: Busy 0.9.5: Puzzles in their room, and every screen in your language
item.description: Play the puzzles in their room: on each game, tap In the room for a real wooden board in the Puzzle Parlour. Every place opens with a short film, and follows the seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Rooms that follow your own work: boxes on the stock shelves, unpaid invoices in the pigeonholes, a leaf on the trellis for every skill, and a drawer label that glows before a document expires. Every screen now speaks your language, Olaf, Ivy and Juno included.

item.title: Busy 0.9.4: Busy speaks your language
item.description: Busy now speaks Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese as well as English. Local rules for each country: the right currency and VAT rates, invoices and reminders in six languages, and letters that name your country's law.

item.title: Busy 0.9.3: Your guide is alive
item.description: Rivet, Pim and Tuck now stand in the room on your home screen, and turn their head to follow you. The rooms follow the clock: in the morning, by day or in the evening, with the light to match.

item.title: Busy 0.9.2: A guide who says what needs you
item.description: Your guide says one line on the home screen about what needs you most, like the last day to cancel a contract or an overdue invoice. The rooms look better, with proper objects: the van, the counter, the glasshouse door, the jar of wins.

item.title: Busy 0.9.1: Every app has its own place
item.description: Each app opens in its own place: the Workshop, the Glasshouse, Tuck's house and the Puzzle Parlour. Every tool has its own room, and the top bar jumps straight to any other tool.

item.title: Busy 0.9.0: Busy as free apps for Mac and Windows
item.description: Busy Business, Busy Growth, Busy Home and Busy Games as free apps for Mac and Windows, one for each part of your life. Your files stay in your own folder as plain files. No account, nothing sent to us.
